project_name: Big Boss in the Lands Between
description: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain mechanics integrated into Elden Ring. Play as Big Boss with a full MGSV weapon arsenal, stealth detection system, helicopter air support, and companion buddies in the Lands Between.
source_game: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain
author: discopapier-cyber

player_character.name: Big Boss
player_character.description: The legendary soldier from MGSV now traverses the Lands Between with all his tactical expertise and weaponry.

weapon_system.description: Full MGSV weapon pool with MGSV stat scaling, bypassing Elden Ring's upgrade system

stealth_system.description: MGSV detection phases fully integrated into Elden Ring combat

detection_phases.description: Enemy unaware of Big Boss's presence
Enemy suspicious, searching for Big Boss
Enemy aware of Big Boss, combat imminent
Full combat engaged, all enemies alerted

mechanics.name: Crouch Movement
mechanics.description: Reduced noise and visibility while moving slowly

mechanics.name: Tall Grass Hiding
mechanics.description: Hide in vegetation to avoid detection

mechanics.name: Sound Masking
mechanics.description: Environmental sounds mask footsteps (rain, thunder, machinery)

mechanics.name: Tranquilizer-based Non-lethal Approach
mechanics.description: Use tranquilizers to neutralize enemies without raising alerts

helicopter_support.description: Call for air support and fast travel via helicopter

features.name: Helicopter Gunfire
features.description: Call in gunship for covering fire during combat

features.name: Airstrike
features.description: Request airstrike on marked enemy positions

features.name: Helicopter Extraction
features.description: Fast travel to any previously visited location via helicopter

buddy_system.description: MGSV buddies available as summonable companions in Elden Ring

combat_integration.description: MGSV mechanics seamlessly integrated with Elden Ring boss encounters

features.name: Boss Weakness Detection
features.description: Identify boss vulnerabilities using MGSV reconnaissance tactics

features.name: Dynamic Stealth Approach
features.description: Option to initiate boss fights stealthily before full combat engagement

features.name: Companion Synergy
features.description: Use Quiet or Diamond Dogs to support boss strategies

features.name: Environmental Tactics
features.description: Utilize terrain and sound masking for strategic advantages

enemies.description: All Elden Ring bosses remain as they are, now challenged with MGSV mechanics and weapons
enemies.scaling: MGSV weapon stats maintain their original balance

hud_updates.stealth_indicators: Alert level display and detection phase visualization
